historical_record.description: The site held an existing two-story mortuary building.

The City Planning Commission upheld the preliminary negative declaration for the construction of two four-story residential buildings with a total of 13 units and the demolition of an existing two-story mortuary building.

The City Planning Commission approved with conditions as modified the conditional use for development on a lot size greater than 5,000 square feet, modifying the project at the 4th floor on the north Dolores-facing facade and adding a subterranean parking level.
